newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's FESCO sees 1997 profit 80 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia's FESCO sees 1997 profit 80 bln rbls.

text.p: Russia's Far Eastern Shipping Company (FESCO) will make 80 billion roubles in profit in 1997 from its transport fleet operations and over $20 million from two ships sales, FESCO's president said.
Pre-tax profit 53.0 bln rbls 242 bln rbls
Dry cargo fleet profit 4.40 bln n/a
NOTE - Full Russian name is OAO Dalnevostochnoye Morskoye Parokhodstvo.

FESCO's president Viktor Miskov told Reuters that shareholders' meeting approved a 0.5 percent dividend per 1,000 rouble share. In 1995 FESCO paid 50 percent per 1,000 rouble share, but the payout remains the same, as the company carried out a 100-for-one bonus issue in 1996 to revalue assets.
Miskov said FESCO's assets amounted to 4.53 trillion roubles by FESCO's estimates and to $600 million by European Bank for Reconstruction and Development estimates.

The State Property Committee owns 19.8 percent of FESCO, Partnyorstvo investment corporation owns 6.1 percent, AO Fes-Invest 6.8 percent, Bank Dalnevostochny - 5.7 percent, Bank of Bermuda - 2.6 percent, AO CS First Boston - 15.8 percent and Crawford Holding - 16.2 percent.
